_comment: Azure CDN + Blob Storage SRI Asset Pipeline Manifest
_description: This manifest documents the Subresource Integrity (SRI) hash pipeline for all CSS/JS assets served via Azure CDN. SRI hashes are generated at build time by the Azure DevOps pipeline and injected into HTML master pages.

assets._note: SRI hash generated at build time by Azure DevOps pipeline task 'Generate-SRI-Hashes'

remediatedViolations.ruleName: External Stylesheets Without SRI from CDN
remediatedViolations.fix: Removed insecure @import from external CDN. Replaced with self-hosted @font-face declarations referencing Azure Blob Storage / Azure CDN paths. SRI enforcement is applied at the HTML <link> tag level via this pipeline manifest.
remediatedViolations.sriInjectionTarget: All .Master pages and .aspx pages that include demo.css via <link rel='stylesheet'> must have integrity and crossorigin attributes injected by the Azure DevOps build pipeline.

pipelineTaskExample.script: openssl dgst -sha384 -binary assets/css/demo.css | openssl base64 -A | sed 's/^/sha384-/'
